verdict.rationale: The privacy policy's definition of "the App" references Instinct's own "Mac OS and mobile applications", so first-party mobile apps exist. The homepage, however, stresses that there are "no new interfaces" and users text or call the agent. Reviewers describe using it through iMessage/WhatsApp rather than a dedicated app. Missing for 10: confirmation of separate iOS and Android apps, any documentation of mobile app features or parity, and hands-on evidence of the mobile apps being used.
